description: Vedic marriage/relationship compatibility matching. Requires birth details for BOTH male and female. Guna Milan uses 36-point Ashtakoot system (North Indian) scoring 8 factors: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, Nadi. 18+/36 is acceptable. Kundali adds Mangal Dosha cross-check. Nakshatra Porutham is 10-factor South Indian. Thirumana Porutham is Tamil marriage matching. Cost: $0.040-0.048/call.
